name: blueprint/mail-flow
description: A local-credentials mail workflow: the himalaya CLI reads the user's own mailbox, the triage pattern prioritizes, tasks and events carry the follow-ups
ingredients: rh_run himalaya (credentials stay in the local CLI config, never in the plugin)
recipe: list the mailbox via rh_run (collect mode) -> classify each thread into the closed priority set -> extract the ask and deadline -> board follow-ups as tasks and schedule the time-sensitive ones as events
pitfalls: mail credentials live in the local CLI config - the plugin never sees them
collect mode bounds listing output - paginate large mailboxes
a reply is yours to write - the tools prioritize only
ignore is a decision too - record it
